system.description:
• Effect: Your illusions are partly made of shadowstuff.
  • Damage your Illusion spells deal to a creature that believes them is real: it can reduce the creature to 0 HP and doesn't fade when the illusion ends.
  • Your spells that deal half damage to believers (such as Shadow Monsters) deal full damage instead.
  • A creature that sees through the illusion takes no damage from it, as normal.
  • This applies to every Illusion spell you cast.

rules.value: Half-Real: your Illusion spells' damage to a creature that believes them is real (it can drop it to 0 HP and doesn't fade); half-damage illusions (Shadow Monsters) deal full.
